summary: A Yes vote enacts a City of Twentynine Palms transactions and use (sales) tax.

tax.text: A Yes vote supports a 1% sales tax expected to raise about $2 million annually for essential city services and facilities.
tax.quote: Measure G asks voters to choose whether or not to approve a 1% sales tax, which would provide approximately $2 million annually, until ended by voters.

tax.text: The No position opposes Measure G’s proposed 1% sales tax for city services.
